verdict.summary: Round 4 remains correct and complete. The new KEEP-list documentation consistently preserves push-to-main coverage measurement as the load-bearing backstop after merge-group demotion. The structural test is non-vacuous: its frozen upstream sets exactly match the live workflow for all three coverage jobs; any added conditional pre-job in `needs:` fails directly, while job-level `needs.<job>...` references are independently rejected. This complements the existing event-envelope assertions and covers the planned `queue-validated` guard shapes without changing production behavior. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity issue is evident. The focused unittest could not execute because PyYAML is unavailable, but the test and corresponding live workflow definitions were inspected directly.
